last.verdict: Solid quarter, but third-quarter profit and bookings outlook came in light.

reasons.label: Soft profit outlook
reasons.text: Q3 adjusted EPS guidance of $0.84–$0.88 landed slightly below Wall Street's forecast.

reasons.label: Bookings guide light
reasons.text: Q3 gross bookings guidance midpoint of about $59.25B sat below the roughly $59.3B consensus.

reasons.label: Revenue slight miss
reasons.text: Revenue of $14.19B (up 12%) trailed the $14.24B estimate despite bookings up 24%.

story: Uber has beaten on bookings for several quarters, but stock moves keep following guidance. Weak profit outlooks sent shares down about 5% in November 2025 and again in February 2026. Strong bookings guidance lifted shares roughly 10% in May. This August's soft outlook brought the drop back.
